“Cloud & DevOps without Linux” illusion\n\n“I work with AWS.”\n“I deploy on Kubernetes.”\n“I do DevOps.”\n\nBut you panic when something breaks in the terminal.\n\nCloud and DevOps make it look like you can skip the basics.\nDashboards, YAML, managed services — everything feels abstract.\n\nUntil it doesn’t.\n\nWithout Linux fundamentals:\n\t•\tPermissions feel random\n\t•\tContainers behave “weirdly”\n\t•\tNetworking issues become guesswork\n\t•\tAutomation breaks under pressure\n\nLinux isn’t optional.\nIt’s the layer everything runs on:\ncontainers, CI/CD runners, cloud VMs, Kubernetes nodes.\n\nAI, Cloud, and DevOps don’t remove fundamentals.\nThey punish you faster for ignoring them.\n\nTools change.\nPlatforms evolve.\nLinux stays.","attributesV2":[],"accessibilityTextAttributesV2":[],"accessibilityText":null,"$recipeTypes":["com.linkedin.eef75d155c668c3b00b0e743b8ee49d7"],"$type":"com.linkedin.voyager.dash.common.text.TextViewModel"},"$recipeTypes":["com.linkedin.2e760b9de70c057b595f6ac667615390"],"$type":"com.linkedin.voyager.dash.feed.component.commentary.CommentaryComponent"},"additionalContents":[]},{"actionType":"hidePostWithConfirmation","entityUrn":"urn:li:fsd_hidePostAction:(urn:li:fsd_updateActions:(urn:li:activity:7411491348291297280,MAIN_FEED,EMPTY,urn:li:reason:-,urn:li:adCreative:-),HIDE_WITH_CONFIRMATION)","type":"HIDE_WITH_CONFIRMATION","preDashEntityUrn":"urn:li:fs_hidePostAction:urn:li:fs_updateV2Actions:(urn:li:activity:7411491348291297280,MAIN_FEED,EMPTY,-,-)","$recipeTypes":["com.linkedin.ff6d8f17b3e0169a576c17702c77dbab"],"$type":"com.linkedin.voyager.dash.feed.controlmenu.HidePostAction"},{"actionType":"hidePostWithConfirmation","entityUrn":"urn:li:fsd_hidePostAction:(urn:li:fsd_updateActions:(urn:li:activity:7410297409030885376,MAIN_FEED,EMPTY,urn:li:reason:-,urn:li:adCreative:-),HIDE_WITH_CONFIRMATION)","type":"HIDE_WITH_CONFIRMATION","preDashEntityUrn":"urn:li:fs_hidePostAction:urn:li:fs_updateV2Actions:(urn:li:activity:7410297409030885376,MAIN_FEED,EMPTY,-,-)","$recipeTypes":["com.linkedin.ff6d8f17b3e0169a576c17702c77dbab"],"$type":"com.linkedin.voyager.dash.feed.controlmenu.HidePostAction"},{"entityUrn":"urn:li:fsd_updateActions:(urn:li:activity:7411491348291297280,MAIN_FEED,EMPTY,urn:li:reason:-,urn:li:adCreative:-)","preDashEntityUrn":"urn:li:fs_updateV2Actions:(urn:li:activity:7411491348291297280,MAIN_FEED,EMPTY,-,-)","$recipeTypes":["com.linkedin.25d2c816eb29483233f8a835217d9a54"],"$type":"com.linkedin.voyager.dash.feed.controlmenu.UpdateActions"},{"entityUrn":"urn:li:fsd_updateActions:(urn:li:activity:7411370519113121793,MAIN_FEED,EMPTY,urn:li:reason:-,urn:li:sponsoredCreative:1100784903)","preDashEntityUrn":"urn:li:fs_updateV2Actions:(urn:li:activity:74 AboutAbout

Cloud Architect and Reliability Engineer since 2008, specializing in Linux, infrastructure, and distributed systems. Designs and operates cloud-native platforms using engineering principles to enhance reliability, observability, security, and cost efficiency. Focuses on data/GenAI workloads, including RAG platforms for highly regulated, mission-critical, and security-sensitive environments.

Core Skills:

Cloud & Platforms: Cloud architecture AWS (Certified) and Azure (Certified)
GenAI & Data Platforms: RAG stacks, data pipelines, analytics and ML platforms
Infrastructure as Code / Automation: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, GitOps
Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes, ECS, Fargate, Docker
Observability: Logs, metrics, tracing (Dynatrace, Prometheus, OTEL, Splunk, CloudWatch, Grafana)
Security & Compliance: Hardening, vulnerability remediation, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2
SRE & Reliability: SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, incident response, RCAs, toil reduction.
